summary: Frontend-only test of the 4 one-click demo logins on the web panel (Admin, Partner, Customer, Merchant). All four logins succeed with no CORS errors, no 'Demo login failed' toast, correct success toast ('Demo login: <name>'), and correct role landing pages. All /api/auth/send-otp and /api/auth/verify-otp calls returned 200 on the same origin (window.location.origin fallback in api.js works as intended).

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/partner/alert-prefs is called twice from the customer session and returns 403 (partner-only endpoint). Not blocking, but pollutes console and generates unnecessary requests. Should be role-gated so it only fires for role=partner.

issues: Recharts warning: 'width(-1)/height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' spammed ~14x on initial render — add minHeight/aspect to ResponsiveContainer parent

action_items: Gate /api/partner/alert-prefs call to role=partner only (avoids 403 spam on /account for customer sessions).
Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer parent sizing in admin dashboard to eliminate initial width/height=-1 warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: web_panel/src/lib/api.js same-origin fallback (window.location.origin) is working correctly — verified via network trace, all /api/auth/* calls are same-origin 200.
Login.jsx quickLogin flow works end-to-end for all 4 roles; success toast shows account name and navigation to role home is correct.
test_credentials: One-click demo — no manual creds used. OTP 123456 for all roles per spec.
seed_data_creation: None — used backend self-seeded demo accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 demo login buttons on /login (data-testid demo-admin/demo-partner/demo-customer/demo-merchant) work. Landing routes: admin→/admin, partner→/partner, customer→/account, merchant→/merchant. Auth uses /api/auth/send-otp then /api/auth/verify-otp — both same-origin 200. Side observation: customer portal spuriously calls /api/partner/alert-prefs (403 x2).
